meetings.title: Booth demo dry run
transcript: Maya: Dry run of the booth demo. Sam, go.
Sam: Screen one, a carrier books a 7am slot. Screen two, Smart Slots suggests 9:30 because the dock is overloaded. Screen three waits for the slot picker build.
Leila: The build is up as PR #241.
Maya: How long is the full demo?
Sam: Two minutes forty. We should get it under two.
Jordan: Booth visitors will ask about pricing first.
Maya: Then pricing goes on the one-pager, with the same numbers as the pricing page.
